ALDER.gloss: wood of any of various alder trees
ALDER.definition: Wood of any of various alder trees; resistant to underwater rot; used for bridges etc.

REAL.gloss: being or occurring in fact or actuality
REAL.definition: Being or occurring in fact or actuality; having verified existence; not illusory.

READ.gloss: interpret something that is written or printed
READ.definition: Interpret something that is written or printed.

LEAD.example: We lead him to our chief.

DARE.definition: Take upon oneself; act presumptuously, without permission.
DARE.example: How dare you call my lawyer?

EARL.gloss: a British peer ranking below a marquess and above a viscount
EARL.definition: A British peer ranking below a marquess and above a viscount.

ARE.gloss: a unit of surface area equal to 100 square meters
ARE.definition: A unit of surface area equal to 100 square meters.

DEAL.gloss: act on verbally or in some form of artistic expression
DEAL.definition: Act on verbally or in some form of artistic expression.

RED.definition: Red color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of blood.

ERA.gloss: a period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event
ERA.definition: A period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event.

EAR.gloss: the sense organ for hearing and equilibrium
EAR.definition: The sense organ for hearing and equilibrium.

DALE.definition: An open river valley (in a hilly area).

ALE.gloss: a general name for beer made with a top fermenting yeast
ALE.definition: A general name for beer made with a top fermenting yeast; in some of the United States an ale is (by law) a brew of more than 4% alcohol by volume.

LARD.gloss: soft white semisolid fat obtained by rendering the fatty tissue of the hog
LARD.definition: Soft white semisolid fat obtained by rendering the fatty tissue of the hog.
